name: Oxygen canister
brief: MK-146 Oxygen canister: the pickup Abbie grabs to top up her air. Round 2, matched to the pick: a stout blue capsule with an off-white front plate holding a warm window (it glows while there's air inside), a dark base ring, a valve block on top with a green "full" ring, and a side strap. Diegetic: the window and ring dim as it empties.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
